message.title: Arribatec Group ASA – Third quarter 2025 financial results
message.body:
(Oslo, Norway, 30 October 2025) Arribatec Group ASA (OSE: ARR, Arribatec) is pleased to report another strong quarter marked by solid revenue growth and continued EBITA improvement. For Q3 2025, the Group achieved revenues of NOK 137 million, representing a 20% year over year increase. EBITA reached NOK 14.6m, corresponding to a 10,7% margin. 

Arribatec Group ASA will host a web presentation for the third quarter financial results 2025 on Thursday 30 October 2025 10:00 CET. 

The presentation will be streamed at: https://www.arribatec.com/arribatec-q3-2025/

Ole Jakob Kjølvik, Interim CEO, Arribatec Group ASA: +47 915 98 935 
Magnus Hofshagen, CFO, Arribatec Group ASA: +47 484 195  

About Arribatec | www.arribatec.com Arribatec is a software and consulting company headquartered in Oslo. With a customer-centric engagement model combined with a deep system, integration, and domain competence, Arribatec builds long-term strategic partnerships with a broad customer base. Arribatec serves more than 1700 companies spread over 25 countries and various industries in the private and public sectors. The company employs over 300 people with offices in 10 countries and is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange under the ticker code ARR.
